title: Validate Analytics Events
description: Verify every funnel event, conversions, and dashboards before launch.
summary: Launch funnel events, conversion dual-writes, and dashboard consumers are instrumented and mechanically verified on this branch. Isolated Row 150 is 16/16 PASS. Isolated Row 84 is 11/11 PASS. Row 151 consumes those events and is 40/42 PASS; the two residual fails are pre-existing empty-state string-match checks (view renders N/A, test looks for lowercase n/a), not missing funnel events. Production Postgres write/read-back was not re-run here because POSTGRES_URL is not present on this workstation. Founder acceptance is not claimed.

knownFindings.finding: Row 151 D7 and D13 still FAIL. Inspected values are already null/empty as required (appToday=null, appOpen=null, onboardingToday=null, emptyRegRate=null, emptyAov=null, emptySessions=0). The checks also require view source to contain lowercase 'n/a' string literals. launch-dashboard-view.tsx renders 'N/A' for nulls (`row.today === null ? "N/A"`, count/rate/money formatters). This is a pre-existing Row 151 test/view string-case mismatch, not a missing funnel event or conversion.
